audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer names Powder Keg as the tracked cooldown. Powder Keg has no cooldown in the kit data (cd '0', cost '0') — kegs are a placement resource, not a punish window. The cooldown that actually gates your all-in is Remove Scurvy (W), 22/20/18/16/14s.
audit.why: Riot text: kegs are uncovered at a location and detonate when he attacks them; Remove Scurvy 'cures crowd control effects and restores Health', which removes the Bear Trap slow your dash-back relies on.
audit.corrected: Difficulty rewritten around baiting Remove Scurvy (22s at rank 1) and fighting in the gaps between chained kegs, not around a non-existent keg cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five of seven chart rows contradicted both the packet chart and this page's own whys text. win[0]/phases[0].side said Gangplank while whys[0] and spikes[1] both say Kled wins the level-1 trade outright; rows 2, 3 and 4 said Kled/Kled/Gangplank while their whys say 'genuinely even', 'neither side owns the wave' and 'the lane stays a skill check'; row 5 said Kled while whys[5] ends 'this window is his'.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Kled / Skill / Skill / Skill / Skill / Gangplank / Kled, and the mirror audit already moved the Gangplank side onto that same chart, so leaving these would break the mirror as well as the page.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 2, 3, 4 and 5 flipped in matched full/content pairs to Kled / Skill / Skill / Skill / Gangplank, with the ratings moved with them and the two generic whys that contradicted the new sides rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer wrote 'Beartrap'; the ability is Bear Trap on a Rope (Q). Remove Scurvy's cleanse — the single interaction that decides this lane — appeared nowhere in the full layer, and Cannon Barrage's true damage was absent from itemization.
audit.why: Kled Q shackles first and only yanks if the shackle survives a short duration, so a cleanse mid-shackle cancels both the pull and the bonus damage. Cannon Barrage carries the trueDamage flag, so stacking armour does not answer it.
audit.corrected: Real name used, Remove Scurvy's 22s cleanse written into breakdown.cooldowns, report[5] and the mid text, and Grievous Wounds plus the true-damage point written into itemization and the don'ts.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.early, content.mid and content.late were all written in the first person ('I stick Bear Trap', 'my win condition'), breaking the second-person coaching voice used everywhere else on the site.
audit.why: The approved quality bar is the user's second-person voice; a page that switches to first person mid-read is the most visible defect on this matchup.
audit.corrected: All three prose blocks rewritten in second person at the same length, with the anti-heal and true-damage facts folded into late.

edits.before: Level 1 is mine for once — Gangplank only has a single un-chained keg and no Sheen proc, so I stick Bear Trap (Q) for the slow and percent-max-HP chunk, throw a Skaarl auto, and win the first trade before his barrel chain or Remove Scurvy matter. From level 2 it tightens: my E-W-E re-E (dash through, Violent Tendencies shots, dash back through the mark) is a real all-in, but if I overstep into a fully-chained barrel detonation he free-trades my mount HP. Fight in the gaps between his kegs, keep Q for the slow that lets the re-E land, and don't let him poke Skaarl low from range while I wait.

From level 2 it tightens: your E-W-E re-E (dash through, Violent Tendencies shots, dash back through the mark) is a real all-in, but overstep into a fully-chained detonation and he free-trades your mount HP. Fight in the gaps between his kegs, keep Q for the slow that lets the re-E land, and don't let him poke Skaarl low from range while you wait.

edits.before: Through 4-6 this is a genuine skill lane. My win condition is the short all-in: Q to stick him, E in, W shotgun shots, then re-E back through the mark — that burst plus remount sustain out-trades his single-keg pokes if I catch him mid-chain. But Remove Scurvy (W) cleanses my Q slow and heals, so I bait it with an early Q before I commit, or my dash-back whiffs the mark. At 6 my R lets me engage off a gank or knock him off a primed barrel, but his level 6 is a global R too, so neither of us takes the lane outright — it's about who lands their setup first.

But Remove Scurvy (W, 22s at rank 1) cleanses your Q slow and heals, so bait it with an early Q before you commit, or the dash-back whiffs the mark. At 6 your R engages off a gank or knocks him off a primed barrel, but his 6 is a global R too, so neither of you takes the lane outright — it's who lands their setup first.

edits.before: First item is his window, not mine: once Gangplank has Sheen/Trinity and Infinity Edge his crit barrels detonate from screens away, Remove Scurvy cleanses the Q slow my whole combo relies on, and he chunks Skaarl before I can re-E in. That's the patch where I'm most likely to lose tempo. But if I've kept the lane even and snowballed even a little, the 2+ item window swings back to me in a straight fight — my Bear Trap percent-max-HP and remount Violent Tendencies shots still shred him, and a re-E onto a caught-out GP deletes him before his autos answer. Don't sit and poke him; catch him with R, all-in, and remount — that's the only way I beat a scaling Gangplank, not by waiting.

Keep the lane even and the 2+ item window swings back in a straight fight — Bear Trap's percent-max-HP and remount Violent Tendencies shots still shred him, and a re-E onto a caught-out GP deletes him before his autos answer. Don't sit and poke him; catch him with R, all-in, and remount.
